messages:
sam: Anyone else seeing multi-GPU jobs in eu-central suddenly hit NCCL timeouts? Got a bunch of 'allreduce failed: ret=-61 (Unreachable peer)' between 03:40-04:00 UTC. Affects the p2-large pool.

lina: Yep, saw the same alerts. Pods restarted but some stayed Failed. dmesg on a few hosts shows IBV errors.

arjun: Can you paste ibstat / ibv_devinfo snippets? Also check kernel logs for mlx5/fw errors.

sam: Paste: ```
# ibv_devinfo -v | grep -A3 port
port 1: state: PORT_ACTIVE (4)
  max_mtu: 4096, active_mtu: 4096
# dmesg | tail -n 30
mlx5_core 0000:af:00.0: firmware error recovered, resetting
mlx5_core 0000:af:00.0: QP 0x7f7: IBV_EVENT_QP_FATAL
```

mike: On a couple nodes ethtool shows MTU = 1500 while peers are 9000. Could be PMTU changes. We rolled a kernel bump last week though.

lina: Confirmed on gnode-047: /sys/class/net/eth0/mtu -> 1500, others in the same rack 9000.

arjun: MTU mismatch on the RoCE path explains dropped RDMA fragments -> NCCL timeouts. Check `ibdev2netdev`, `ip -s link`, `ethtool -S eth0` for tx/rx drops.

sam: ethtool -S eth0 shows: tx_dropped: 124893, tx_queue_0_drops: 0, rx_errors: 9. ibv_devinfo shows occasional BAD_PKEY or MR registration failures.

katie: I opened NW ticket NW-890 with switch team and attached packet captures. They called out VXLAN offload + jumbo frames on the ToR might be fragmenting RDMA packets.

incidents-bot: Incident INC-890 opened (P2) — pinging @networking @eng-runtime for triage.

mike: Workaround we tried: set MTU=9000 on the affected hosts and bounce kubelet + restart pods. That restored most jobs but one host still reports 'GPUDirect MR reg failed: -12'.

lina: -12 could beENOMEM when MR registering. Check kernel logs for oom_killer and `sysctl -a | grep mem` around the timeframe. Also verify hugepages config.

sam: For immediate mitigation I switched canary training to NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME and forced TCP fallback for 2h to keep customer jobs alive. Not ideal but prevented more failures.

arjun: Long-term: preflight that verifies `ip link show` MTU consistency across nodes in a placement group before scheduling multi-GPU jobs. Also add an ib sanity check: `ibdev2netdev` mapping and small ibv_fork_test.

katie: Network says ToR VXLAN offload is the culprit in some pods. They will disable offload on the fabric for the affected leafs and re-run validation.

mike: Also spotted that a subset of nodes had mismatched firmware on mlx5 (FW 42 vs 41). Plan: schedule a controlled FW sync for the pool.

arjun: Good to document: mixing VXLAN offload + jumbo frames + RoCEv2 on path = intermittent fragment/PMTU blackholes. Avoid mixing or gate the feature on nodes serving RDMA traffic.

sam: Agreed. Proposal: (1) preflight MTU/ib mapping check in scheduler, (2) alert when ethtool MTU differs across N nodes in a subnet, (3) firmware audit for mlx5 in the p2-large pool.

katie: I'll add the three items to the eng-runtime backlog and update NW ticket. Also adding an alert to surface `tx_dropped` > 10k in 5m for eth0 on RDMA hosts.

lina: One more note: add a test during node-join that runs `nvidia-smi topo -m` + small NCCL allreduce to catch this before going live.

sam: Thanks everyone — will follow up when NW confirms offload toggle and when FW sync is scheduled.

katie: :thumbsup: updating tickets and adding the preflight task.
